title: Realtime attribution engine for request-level cost & latency slicing
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and implement a realtime attribution engine that computes cost and latency breakdowns per request, route, model variant, and customer. The goal is to provide the Console and downstream reports with a single authoritative decomposition that answers: how much of a request's cost is kernel compute vs queuing vs KV cache inefficiency vs routing/fallback overhead; which model variant contributed tokens; and how latency splits across queue, kernel, and network for SLO debugging. This ticket covers the streaming enrichment pipeline, the separation of realtime vs authoritative nightly rollups, materialized views for fast dashboard queries, and the reconciliation step against the billing ledger. We will use a hybrid approach: Flink streaming jobs for near-realtime per-request attribution, ClickHouse materialized views for low-latency dashboard slicing, and a nightly Spark job to produce authoritative day-level rollups that feed billing reconciliation and long-term analytics. Key data sources include request traces from the serving runtime, telemetry from kernel probes, routing decisions from the router service, token counts from the tokenizer pipeline, and the cost ledger export. The attribution model is token-weighted time-slice allocation for shared GPU batches plus explicit assignment for KV cache hits and per-request fixed costs (route lookup, SLO penalties). Deliverables: streaming enrichment jobs, transform SQL views, GraphQL endpoints for Console, reconciliation job and tests, and dashboards for validation.
acceptance_criteria: Per-request attribution computed and available in ClickHouse materialized view within 30s of event arrival for 95% of requests
Dashboard query (single customer, 30-day window, aggregated by route+model) returns under 2s for 95th percentile
Nightly authoritative rollups reconcile to billing ledger within 2% for total cost and within 5% for per-route splits across a representative sample of customers
Attribution model documents outline how batching allocation, KV cache hits, and fallback routing overhead are assigned and approved by Product
End-to-end tests cover mismatch scenarios (missing telemetry, partial traces, delayed ledger) and produce audit logs for each reconciliation failure
tasks: Prototype Flink enrichment job: join runtime traces + routing decisions + tokenizer events
Implement token-weighted time-slice allocation algorithm with configurable knobs
Create ClickHouse materialized views and retention policy for per-request slices
Build GraphQL read endpoints for Console cost/latency breakdowns
Nightly Spark job to compute authoritative day-level rollups and reconcile with billing ledger
Add reconciliation alerts and runbook in PagerDuty for >2% drift
Performance tests with synthetic high-throughput workloads and 99th percentile latency measurement
Documentation: README, attribution model explainer, and Console UI contract
